sloka: एवमुक्त्वा दुहितरं समाश्वास्य च भार्गवः ।पुनर्जगाम ब्रह्मर्षिर्भवनं स्वं महायशाः ।। ७.५८.२४ ॥
transliteration: evamuktvā duhitaraṁ samāśvāsya ca bhārgavaḥ ।punarjagāma brahmarṣirbhavanaṁ svaṁ mahāyaśāḥ ।। 7.58.24 ॥

translations.english: Having thus spoken and comforted his daughter, the highly renowned Brahmarshi Chyavana, the son of Bhrigu, returned to his own abode.
